verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that returns HTTP 200 and describes Adyen's developer and merchant documentation. A second probe confirms the docs pages are served as agent-friendly Markdown (.md) with structured front-matter, including the Agentic Commerce pages themselves. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and no evidence of an expanded llms-full.txt or how completely llms.txt indexes the agentic-commerce section.
